_source: Plarium official Artifact Sets reference (pasted by Mike 2026-07-25). VERBATIM chances/effects. This is the GEAR_PROC family of knowledge/RNG_REGISTRY.md — the chance-based (RNG) sets ONLY. Deterministic stat/flat-effect sets are listed under _deterministic_sets and are handled via effectiveStats / flat effects, NOT rolled.
_schema: set -> { pieces, trigger, chance, rng_type, effect, value, turns, notes }. chance is 0-1. null = NOT stated in the source (do not guess — the doc warns granularity/timing can't be inferred from the % alone). rng_type maps to the registry's roll types.
_not_wired: These definitions are CAPTURED, not yet consumed by the sim. Wiring needs per-champion set loadout (read live for captured accounts via the Gestal sync; the manual-entry flow collects gear TIER not SETS). Verify each champ's actual sets before crediting a proc.

Retaliation.notes: counter uses the DEFAULT skill at 75% of standard damage

Avenging.notes: rolled PER debuff placed by enemy, but at most ONE counter; default skill @ 75% dmg

Frostbite.notes: 10% place Freeze on attacker; SEPARATELY 15% chance to BLOCK an incoming Freeze (EFFECT_BLOCK)

Toxic.notes: 2.5% Poison; DEF-independent DoT; INDEPENDENT of any skill debuff roll (doc §15)

Daze.notes: Sleep breaks on any damage — pair with non-damaging placers

Reflex.notes: reduces a RANDOM skill's cooldown by 1; trigger timing not stated in source (needs verification)

Impulse.notes: random skill; trigger timing not stated

Cursed City Merciless.notes: ALSO 15% chance of an Extra Turn (EXTRA_TURN) — variable set, two separate procs

Slayer.notes: repeat = the initial damage multiplier, ALWAYS a NORMAL hit, PURE damage (no crit/affinity). Forge Pass

Affinitybreaker.notes: converts a Weak Hit into a Critical Hit — a SEPARATE roll after the affinity Weak roll (registry #4). +30% C.DMG stat too

Deflection.notes: variable set; also flat +60 ACC/+32% SPD and bonus ACC-scaled damage to debuff-blockers

Stone Skin.notes: Stone Skin buff: 50% block removals/steals; the buff's -85% dmg / debuff-immunity is DETERMINISTIC once up

Feral.notes: Siege set; blocks the Polymorph Blessing's Sheep

Swift Parry.notes: chance NOT stated in source ('a chance of getting an Unkillable buff'). Verify before wiring

_deterministic_sets._note: NOT rolled — flat stat bonuses (via effectiveStats from the sync) or deterministic effects (flat heal/shield/ignore-DEF/damage-reduction). Listed so the RNG/non-RNG split is explicit.

deterministic_effect.Lifesteal: heal 30% of damage dealt — DOES NOT heal off Poison damage (⚠ engine must exclude DoT from lifesteal; it does — lifesteal is on direct-hit dealt, tickDots has none)
deterministic_effect.Bloodthirst: heal 30% of damage per hit (+12% C.Rate) — same Poison exclusion as Lifesteal
deterministic_effect.Destroy: destroy target MAX HP by 40% of damage; cap 8%/skill (per-skill not per-hit); floor 40% of original; AoE hits only the Leader-position enemy
deterministic_effect.Fury: damage +10/+25/+50% by current-HP band (100-76 / 75-51 / <=50) — deterministic on HP
deterministic_effect.Curing: +20% bonus heal on wearer's own heals; restores destroyed HP by the bonus amount
deterministic_effect.Shield: 30% MAX-HP Shield to all allies 3t at Round start — STACKS across multiple Shield-set wearers
deterministic_effect.Bolster: protected 30% HP ally Shield 3t + 10%/turn wearer heal
deterministic_effect.Regeneration: 15% MAX HP heal at start of turn
deterministic_effect.Frenzy: +5% Turn Meter per enemy-placed debuff (per debuff)
deterministic_effect.Swift Parry (non-proc part): +30% C.DMG/+28% SPD/+25% HP/+50% ignore-DEF + single-target dmg mitigation
